subject: 0327 Exec Flash: ops, OKR alignment & QBR blockers
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: 0327 Exec Flash: ops, OKR alignment & QBR blockers

Morning team — sending the weekly flash ahead of the Friday sync. Brief bullets: please read and flag anything that needs escalation into the QBR. I attached the one-pager and OKR tracker.

Wins:
- Hosted API: rolled out the improved batching kernel to 2 dedicated clusters; p95 generation latency improved ~18% on long-tail queries (see attachment: OKR_tracker_0327.xlsx, row 12).
- Dedicated capacity: signed two month-long reserved commitments with a PLG customer that will move to committed next quarter (internal billing confirmed).

Risks / current blockers:
- Security evidence: Acme (Nina Shah) pushed back on SOC2 evidence timing; procurement expects artifacts by end of next week. If we miss this window, the deal schedule slips (impact: ~$120k ARR this quarter).
- Model rollout: Canary for v2-quant is showing higher token-repetition on a small subset of prompts (rate ~0.8% of requests). Need a root-cause (kernel vs. tokenization) before broader rollout.
- QBR narrative: our cost-per-1M tokens delta vs. competitor needs clearer attribution (quantization + batching). Current slides are thin.

Asks / owners / due dates:
- Maya: coordinate SOC2 artifact handoff to Acme; confirm what they need by COB Tue (Nina is expecting a link to evidence). Please use procurement@acme.com for delivery.
- Marcus: can you validate the p95 latency numbers for the grpc path and give a recommended rollback threshold for v2-quant by EOD Mon?
- Jonas: update the QBR cost slide with a simple breakdown (batching savings / quantization delta / infra amortization) — draft by Wed noon.
- Laura: can you sign off on the escalation language if we need to request a 2-week extension from Acme?

Attachments: QBR_one-pager.pdf, OKR_tracker_0327.xlsx (summary tab highlighted).
Drive/Notion links included below.

Thanks — short and actionable please.

—Kim
Kimberly Park
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: 0327 Exec Flash: ops, OKR alignment & QBR blockers

Thanks Kim — quick clarifying question on OKR 1.2: is the p95 baseline for the metric the hosted API (public) or the dedicated cluster measurements? I want to ensure I'm comparing apples-to-apples before setting a rollback threshold.

I'll start a small repro run against the grpc path and report back by EOD Mon with a suggested threshold (if we see >15% regression at p95 we'll pull canary).

Appreciate the crisp note, Kim. Two asks from me:

1) SOC2 / Acme timeline — can we accelerate? If procurement is waiting on evidence, let's get a minimal evidence bundle together (system architecture diagram + access control summary + recent SOC provider contact) and ship that today. Maya — please confirm what's immediately available and send to procurement@acme.com; loop me if anything looks incomplete.

2) Quick sync — can we carve 15 minutes before EOD to align on the QBR narrative and any escalation language? I'm free 4:15–4:45 PT; if that works for owners please accept. If not, provide a 10-line escalation note and I'll sign off.

Forwarding Kim's original for context.

I'm uploading links to Drive now (see related links). Will send a short cover note to procurement@acme.com and CC Nina Shah by EOD. Attachment placeholder: QBR_deck_slide_draft.pdf (first pass of the cost slide included).
- Marcus: I put you down for the rollback threshold validation; please post results in the shared OKR tracker (row 12) and ping me if you need infra access.
- Jonas: I'll pair with you Monday AM to finalize the cost breakdown — lets block 30m at 9:00 PT.

I've created a brief escalation note for Laura to sign if needed — pasted below. If Laura approves I'll send it to Nina and procurement.

Escalation note (draft):
We appreciate Acme's timeline constraints. To avoid delaying the go-live, we are providing an initial evidence bundle today and will follow with the complete SOC2 report within two weeks. If this timeline is acceptable, we'll proceed with onboarding milestones as scheduled.

I'll accept the 4:15 slot for a quick wrap if that works for everyone.
